### **Verdict**
🚨 **BREAKING CHANGE**

---

### **Impact Analysis**
Removing the `name` field from the `RuleChain` DTO is a **breaking change** that impacts **305 active frontend consumers** across multiple TypeScript files and Angular HTML templates.

---

### **Impacted TypeScript Services & Endpoints**
The following endpoints returned by the client-side HTTP service `ui-ngx/src/app/core/http/rule-chain.service.ts` are impacted because they expect the wire payload mapped to `RuleChain` to contain the `name` field:

| Line No. | HTTP Method | Endpoint Route | Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Line 55** | `GET` | `/api/ruleChains` | Retrieves rule chains; expects `name` |
| **Line 67** | `GET` | `/api/ruleChain/*PARAM*` | Retrieves rule chain by ID; expects `name` |
| **Line 75** | `POST` | `/api/ruleChain/device/default` | Creates default device rule chain; expects `name` |
| **Line 81** | `POST` | `/api/ruleChain` | Saves/updates rule chain; expects `name` |
| **Line 89** | `POST` | `/api/ruleChain/*PARAM*/root` | Sets root rule chain; expects `name` |
| **Line 256** | `GET` | `/api/edge/*PARAM*/ruleChains` | Retrieves edge rule chains; expects `name` |
| **Line 261** | `POST` | `/api/edge/*PARAM*/ruleChain/*PARAM*` | Assigns rule chain to edge; expects `name` |
| **Line 270** | `POST` | `/api/ruleChain/*PARAM*/edgeTemplateRoot` | Sets edge template root rule chain; expects `name` |
| **Line 274** | `POST` | `/api/ruleChain/*PARAM*/autoAssignToEdge` | Automatically assigns rule chain to edge; expects `name` |
| **Line 278** | `DELETE` | `/api/ruleChain/*PARAM*/autoAssignToEdge` | Unassigns rule chain from edge; expects `name` |

---

### **Affected Frontend Files & HTML Templates**
The removal of the `name` field directly cascades into TypeScript type definitions and Angular component templates where the name of the Rule Chain is referenced/rendered:

1. **Model Interfaces:**
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/shared/models/rule-chain.models.ts` (Requires removing the property from the model definition)
2. **HTML Templates / Components with Broken Bindings:**
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/agent-app-profile-list.component.html` (e.g., properties `profile.name`, `p.name` will break)
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/agent-autocomplete.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/agent-deploy-status.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/agent-related-entity-autocomplete.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/dialog/agent-auto-provision-dialog.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/wizard/agent-app-install-flow.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/wizard/agent-app-update-flow.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/agent/wizard/agent-app-upgrade-flow.component.html`
   * `ui-ngx/src/app/modules/home/components/ai/ai-attachment-preview-dialog.component.html`
